submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / identity-preserve. ONE native HD>=1024 RGBA transparent independent animation frame.
Image1 is the Ice Sword Girl frame to edit. Keep its HEAD/HAIR/FACE, BODY scale, ARM-SLEEVE-HAND-WEAPON chains and exact CAMERA/CANVAS positions. Image2 approved Bamboo same-direction contact pose is anatomy ONLY, not identity/props. Image3 definitive Ice identity, image4 approved painted finish. Redraw ONLY pelvis/robe at joints and the two LEGS/BOOTS to implement the NEW sustained-contact gait. Never merely copy old leg pixels or relabel phases.
DIRECTION NORTH pure BACK view running AWAY. The ONE SUPPORT foot throughout frames 01–08 is anatomical RIGHT; LEFT is airborne swing/recovery. This frame 01 is stage 1/8: FRONT position A: support foot lands clearly AHEAD of pelvis along travel, heel first then settling, knee soft; other leg folds behind with sole visible. Distinct initial landing stance.
In pure rear NORTH perspective, the support shoe recedes AHEAD of pelvis toward upper canvas at first (heel approx y88–90%); as body passes it, that same contact projects progressively LOWER/behind the pelvis (middle y91–94%; rear toe push y95–96%). This is ground DEPTH perspective, not raising/lowering the whole character. For THIS frame aim support heel about y89%, on its own screenRIGHT side. Knees/ankles/feet stay oriented NORTH; planted forefoot hidden away from viewer, not broad sole facing camera.
The SAME RIGHT shoe must visibly bear load and contact a consistent virtual ground at its own forward/back depth. Continuous support lasts8 unique frames; there is NO premature switch to LEFT, NO support foot float, NO repeated pose. Natural bent-knee weight acceptance, shin tracks over ankle, toe axis follows run heading. Front/back stride is allowed, sideways duck feet/X-knee twist is not. Short chibi limbs, original boot dimensions; clear connected hip-thigh-knee-ankle, exactly2legs. Other foot never lands during this foot's8-frame stance.
Preserve correct anatomical RIGHT ice sword hand and LEFT talisman hand exactly as image1. Do not change upperbody to compensate leg position, do not translate/rescale whole figure, do not move entire canvas to lowest alpha pixel, no mirroring/copy/interpolation. No shadow, background, effects, guides, grid or text. Genuine transparency and clean polished painted pixels.
